title: Suspicious email asks to click a link
symptom: User received an urgent email asking her to verify her account via a link
user_description: I got an email saying my mailbox will be deleted in 24 hours unless I click a link to verify. Should I do it?

options.text: Click the link to see if it is real
options.why: Clicking is exactly what the attacker wants. A link can install malware or steal credentials.

options.text: Reply to the sender asking if it is genuine
options.why: Confirms to the attacker that your address is active and gives them a chance to continue.

options.text: Forward it to all colleagues as a warning
options.why: Spreads the dangerous email to more people. Report it through the proper channel instead.

options.text: Tell her not to click, report it using the phishing report button or the security team, and then delete it
options.why: Urgent threats and requests to verify an account are classic phishing signs. Reporting lets security protect everyone and removing it stops anyone clicking it by accident.

hints: What feels unusual about the message?
Who should be told so everyone is protected?
real_world_tip: Teach users the warning signs: urgency, threats, unexpected links and sender addresses that look slightly wrong.
